title: A row shows line count and hours only - no money anywhere on the panel
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test.
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. Read a row's summary.
  2. Check the hover card and the Add Service modal.
  3. Confirm no total or price appears anywhere in the panel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each row reads as one summary - the line count and the hours (for example '4 lines · 2.8 hours') - rather than listing its lines.
  • It carries no money: no total on the row, in the hover card, or in the Add Service modal.
  • Nothing in the panel shows a price (an honest figure would need the customer's rate, tax, fees and discounts, which the work order computes once the lines are on it).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R16: “Each row reads as one summary, the line count and the hours, for example 4 lines · 2.8 hours, rather than listing its lines. It carries no money: no total on the row, in the hover card of S16-R7 or in the Add Service modal”
  • S16-N5: “Nothing in the panel shows a price. An honest figure would need the customer's labour rate, tax, fees and discounts, which the work order itself already computes once the lines are on it”
